posture.summary: Mizu is an experimental local inference runtime with a real control plane and placeholder backend execution. It does not yet run real Qwen/Gemma inference with real packed weights and backend math.

privacy_and_security_boundary.privacy: Importer tools operate on local model files. No customer-data, telemetry, retention, or deployment privacy review is recorded; real model assets and caller inputs remain internal until the source owner completes that review.
privacy_and_security_boundary.security: The repository documents bounded import parsing and fail-closed path handling, but does not claim security certification or deployment readiness. Credential, transport, authorization, and multi-tenant review remain open.

owner_and_next_verifier.owner: Mizu source maintainer (runtime and importer evidence owner)
owner_and_next_verifier.next_verifier: Aletheia portfolio evidence review and Jazz Hands packet reconciliation; the Mizu source owner must approve any posture change, and the destination release owner must separately approve any disclosure.
